entries.brief: Edit target: the supplied original SKAZ adult gold dragon portrait. Create a replacement fantasy bestiary UI portrait, square transparent PNG. Preserve its warm metallic gold overlapping scales, intelligent adult dragon eye, paired swept-back horns, cheek fins and two flowing whiskers, painterly realistic fantasy handbook style, no text or frame. Correct the framing: the broad adult head and muzzle must dominate the central 65 percent of the canvas width, with a short powerful neck, much bigger than in the reference. Compact the silhouette by bending the horns gently back and keeping whiskers closer to the jaw so the whole silhouette fits with 10 percent safety margins. Three-quarter view, facing left. Head must read strongly in a 40px circle and grayscale; strong jaw planes, warm highlights and muted cool shadow. Do not clip horns or whiskers, no long narrow bust, no tiny head, no extra heads or limbs, no background, no UI symbols. Keep species identity and adult maturity; this is an original project artwork revision, not an age change.

entries.brief: Edit target: supplied SKAZ young silver dragon portrait. Original fantasy handbook painterly illustration for a 2014 bestiary. Preserve silver-metallic scales, slender pointed face, smooth flowing swept-back crest and youthful alert eyes. Change framing to a distinct YOUNG age silhouette: show the entire long slender neck, upper chest and shoulders plus both folded wing roots, head smaller relative to the body, lively three-quarter pose facing left, delicate narrow jaw, low unweathered crest, no old heavy brows or giant adult horns. Head, neck and upper torso together form a compact readable silhouette centered with generous 12 percent transparent margins. Not a full-body hatchling, not a close-up ancient head. Soft warm key light and cool neutral shadows, muted silver materials, detailed but clear at 40px grayscale circle. No text, no frame, no glow, no background, no limbs cut at odd joints. Transparent square PNG.

entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D 2014 spell illustration: Continual Flame. One compact bronze handheld sconce with a broad steady golden-orange magical flame emerging above its clean unburnt metal cup. No fuel, no wood, no smoke or sparks, no melting metal: this is light without heat. Painterly fantasy handbook materials, sculpted bold shapes, warm key light cool shadows, clear dark contours. Isolated object fills central 70 percent, generous transparent margins, square transparent PNG, readable at 32px and grayscale. No text, symbols, border, numbers, background, scenery, hand or character.
